properties.name: A design closes against a threshold the owner declares, and the closure report names the first hole
properties.statement: One read answers whether the design closes: every live requirement traced to a capability with a passing verification; every budget inside its limit with the declared margin; every boundary between coupled parts specified on both sides; no open decision that the scheduled increment depends on; no quantity without a source. Each leg reports its count, what it swept ("budgets: 1 modelled; seams: 13 of 72 declared"), and its worst offender, so a leg with nothing to run on cannot read as clean. The verdict is computed against a closure threshold the project declared — 100% is a legal declaration, and so is "traceability and budgets only" — and a project with no declared threshold reads "no closure criterion stated", never a default. Closure is a report, not a gate: a release may be cut while the design does not close, and the report says so.
